title: IKEA Recalls KULLEN 3 Drawer Chest Due to Tip-Over/ Entrapment Hazards
hazard: IKEA is voluntarily recalling KULLEN 3 drawer chest in birch and black/brown. The chest is unstable if it is not anchored to the wall, posing tip over and entrapment hazards.

IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of the IKEA 365+ VÄRDEFULL garlic press, article 305.781.89 only, for units sold from March 2024- May 2025. Small metal pieces can detach from the garlic press posing a laceration or ingestion risk.

title: IKEA recalls certain VARMFRONT Power Banks due to fire hazard
hazard: IKEA is announcing a voluntary recall of certain VARMFRONT power banks. Due to a manufacturing issue the power banks can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
